kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-cost-rule --gw-cluster-id pg-xxxxxxx --model-name gpt-4 --model-service-id ms-xxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCostRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the model, such as gpt-4 or qwen-turbo
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the model service
parameters.name: model_service_id

parameters.help_en: The input cost points per million tokens. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 输入百万 token 成本点（默认 0）
parameters.name: input_cost_points_per_million

parameters.help_en: The effective target type. Valid values: global, consumerGroup, and consumer. Default value: global
parameters.help_zh: 生效目标类型, 取值 global/consumerGroup/consumer, 默认 global
parameters.name: effective_target_type

parameters.help_en: The effective target value. This parameter is required when the effective target type is not global
parameters.help_zh: 生效目标值, 生效目标类型非 global 时必填
parameters.name: effective_target_value

parameters.help_en: The output cost points per million tokens. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 输出百万 token 成本点（默认 0）
parameters.name: output_cost_points_per_million

parameters.help_en: The cache read cost points per million tokens. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: Cache 百万 token 成本点（默认 0
parameters.name: cache_cost_points_per_million

parameters.help_en: The explicit cache read cost points per million tokens
parameters.help_zh: 显式缓存读取成本点每百万 Token
parameters.name: explicit_cache_cost_points_per_million

parameters.help_en: The cache creation cost points per million tokens
parameters.help_zh: 缓存创建(写入)成本点每百万 Token
parameters.name: cache_creation_cost_points_per_million

parameters.help_en: The image input cost points per image
parameters.name: image_cost_points_per_count

parameters.help_en: The video input cost points per second
parameters.name: video_cost_points_per_second

parameters.help_en: The tiered price for input tokens (non-cumulative). The value is a JSON array character string. Each element contains Tier and InputCostPointsPerMillion. Valid values for Tier: "" (default tier), 0-32K, 32K-64K, 64K-128K, 128K-256K, 256K-512K, 512K-1M, and 1M+. Example: [{"Tier":"0-32K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1000"},{"Tier":"32K-64K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1800"}]. If this parameter is specified, it takes precedence over InputCostPointsPerMillion. An empty array [] is not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 输入 Token 阶梯价格(非累进), JSON 数组字符串, 元素含 Tier 和 InputCostPointsPerMillion, Tier 取值 ""(默认档)/0-32K/32K-64K/64K-128K/128K-256K/256K-512K/512K-1M/1M+, 例如 [{"Tier":"0-32K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1000"},{"Tier":"32K-64K","InputCostPointsPerMillion":"1800"}]; 提供时优先于 InputCostPointsPerMillion, 不可传 []
parameters.name: input_token_tiers

parameters.help_en: The effective start time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If this parameter is not specified, the rule takes effect immediately
parameters.help_zh: 生效起始时间, 格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, 不传则立即生效
parameters.name: effective_start_time

CostRuleId.description_en: The ID of the cost rule
